# Pulse task #2870: Make accented clip colors substantially more distinct from regular clips

Operation: b1441cb2044a97d17843a2f248e795ed
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User19October2026 native feedback: accented and non-accented colors are much too close and hard to tell apart; make the difference much more extreme. Context interpreted as shared track-inherited clip accent flavor from2697; do not redesign unrelated app primary/secondary controls. Preserve assigned hue and currentpalette (including2793 removalofgray), not randomize or add independent clipcolors.

Duplicate accent search found existing2697/merged315 foundationalpalette+clipflavors and2696 held-intersectionaccent, but no focused strongercontrast follow-up. Preserve old source/acceptance.2828/PR432 coloredtitle work isqueued and mustconsume SAMEupdatedsharedresolver rather than invent a second headerpalette. CurrentAccent/regular/Muted are visualflavors, not invented audioenable/mute semantics.

Inspect actual shared theme clip_fill/flavor/readable-text rules and current rendered audio/MIDI Arrange+Console examples. Increase perceptual separation of Accent versus ordinary non-accented clips substantially using a coherent luminance/chroma treatment within the same hue; don't apply a tinyRGBadjustment or only a contextmenuindicator. Preserve independently meaningful Muted treatment, actual selection outline, hover/disabled/readability and assignedtrackstrip. Selectedstate mustnot flatten bothflavors backinto near-identical colors; labels andwaveform/note graphics remainreadable againsteachfill. Themevariants/highcontrast/customsurface handling shouldreuseexistingresolver. Define finite measuredcolor/contrast expectations BEFOREimplementation, informedbyactualbeforevalues/userintent ratherthan a source-mirroringtest. No exactphotometricparityreferenceor mandatorynewpalette requested.

Implementonceinsharedcolorresolver so all current consumers, including Arrangement/Console audio+MIDI and inheritedcoloredcliptitle, stayconsistent; no schema/model/flavorstate/command/audiochange. Preserve currentcolor/flavor copies/splits/history/currentformat persistence. Keep clipselectionborder/wholetrack-resizeexception2860 andheldintersection2696 distinct; no highlightwash coveringunrelatedtracks.

Acceptance actual productionpalette swatches/paint evidence comparing regular/Accent/Muted forALLcurrentusablehues, selected/unselected andpracticalthemebackgrounds; demonstrablylargerseparation thanbefore andreadable text/content. Actual rendered toggleflavor/trackrecolor→sharedpaint inArrange+Console andcliptitle, stablegeometry/no additional perclipgloballookups, UndoRedo unchanged. Numerical color/readability tests help enforce intendedincrease butnotclaimnativevisualacceptance. ProportionalfocusedlocalUI/themechecks then solemerger currentexactqualification/review/merge; Readyonlyactualmerge, Root optimizednativevisualcheck separate. No app/install/quit/native/hostedCI.

ExistinggeneralUIworker queuesaftercurrent455andcriticalresize/Tab return2813 withotherUIfeatures, onewriter/3workers. Coordinate432bodyfillpassedtoheader/currenttracks paint viafocusedhunks, notwholeoldfilecopy. Supportedcanonicalintake/attach/sourceidentity beforeimplementation; return if'useraccent' maps toa differentactualconcept withevidence ratherthan changingeverythemeaccent.
